lighter_prose.passage: Every run opens with a tail read of that ledger, never the whole of it — its last 40 lines with the run lines set aside, plus any item still owed wherever it sits — and those are the first candidates for the run's spec change. summary: I read the 14 room pages in full or in the passages that matter, and for each of the 20 weak links I read the target and searched both bodies for the other's name. Result: 3 cuts (Endosymbiosis to SUBSTRATE, Image Embedding Standard to SUBSTRATE, Progressive Staging to Modes of Collaboration), 17 labels, 0 retypes, 0 keeps. The pattern: most bare links had a real reason sitting in one body, usually the source (a named ceremony step, a channel, a candidate project) and sometimes only the target (Reflective Practice naming Oblique Portrait and the Concierge; the Guide naming the image standard); the three cuts were shared vocabulary with no sentence on either page. Pairs where both sides hold a bare connects-to (Pheromone Trail and Context Injection, Substrate Skill and Palace Ceremonies, SCHEMA and Four Pillars of Enchanted Agency) should keep one link and lose the other once a label lands. I proposed three newcomer inbounds (Concierge to CHILD, Substrate Skill and Pheromone Trail to SCHEMA — Reference) and six lighter-prose edits. Not settled: whether the Progressive Staging to Modes of Collaboration cut is right (its open question about staging the collaboration is close), whether the Image Embedding Standard to Guide label is worth keeping over a cut, whether forward_vector is required on SCHEMA and Substrate Skill, and whether the Deposit Ceremony's own text names the Palace Worker step (I found no mention). No retype was proposed where the claim lived only on the target page; I preferred a label there.
